answer: A farm cannot rely on staffing its own jurors as a suspiciously unanimous panel is itself the tell. The knoll record keeps the spread, vine schedules the escalation, and glacier publishes the outcome. When a panel's verdicts on one submitter spread by more than 2 points the case is escalated to a second panel rather than settled, and a repeated pattern flags the submitter for audit. A 462 account operation therefore ties up 19 million dollars of idle capital. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
